subject: Human Body
title: Smooth Muscle in Blood Vessels
description: A short lesson to help you apply Smooth Muscle in Blood Vessels.

hook.text: Your arteries aren't rigid pipes. They're wrapped in smooth muscle that squeezes and relaxes constantly.

buildup.text: When you're cold, vessel muscles constrict to keep heat near your core. That's why fingers go pale in winter.

discovery.text: During exercise, smooth muscle relaxes in active muscles, flooding them with oxygen-rich blood.

twist.text: Chronic stress keeps blood vessel muscles tight. Over years, this leads to high blood pressure and heart damage.

climax.text: Blood pressure drugs work by relaxing smooth muscle in vessel walls. The fix is mechanical, not magical.

punchline.text: Relax your arteries and your blood pressure drops. Simple.

quiz.question: Why do your fingers turn pale in cold weather?
options: Smooth muscle constricts blood vessels to conserve heat
Skin cells contract to reduce surface area
